units.source_text: 斋宫下伊势的日子近了，六条妃子心中郁郁不乐。

en.t: As the day for the Saigu to go down to Ise drew near, Lady Rokujo grew deeply melancholy.

units.source_text: 自从左大臣家那位身份高贵的葵姬病死之后，世间众口谣传，谓源氏大将的继配将是六条妃子。

en.t: Ever since the noble Lady Aoi of the Minister of the Left's household had died of illness, people everywhere had been spreading the rumor that Genji's next wife would be Lady Rokujo.

units.source_text: 妃子宫邸内的人也都如此逆料，大家不免动心。

en.t: The people in the lady's mansion expected the same thing, and naturally they were all stirred by the prospect.

units.source_text: 岂知此后大将反而疏远，几乎绝不上门了。

en.t: But unexpectedly, after that the general became even more distant and almost never visited her at all.

units.source_text: 六条妃子失望之余，心中想道：“可知为了那生魂事件，他完全嫌弃我了。”

en.t: In her disappointment, Lady Rokujo thought to herself, "It must be because of that living spirit affair; he has come to loathe me completely."

units.source_text: 她看透了源氏大将的心情之后，便把万缕情丝一刀斩断，专心一意地准备下伊势去。

en.t: Once she understood Genji's feelings, she cut off all the countless threads of attachment at a stroke and devoted herself single-mindedly to preparing to go down to Ise.

units.source_text: 斋宫随带母亲赴伊势修行，古来少有其例。

en.t: There had been few examples since ancient times of a Saigu taking her mother with her to Ise for religious service.

units.source_text: 六条妃子便以女儿年幼不便独行为理由，决心离开这可厌的京华。

en.t: Lady Rokujo therefore used her daughter's youth and the difficulty of traveling alone as her reason, and resolved to leave the hateful capital.

units.source_text: 源氏大将闻此消息，心念妃子此次离京远去，毕竟深可惋惜。

en.t: When Genji heard this news, he thought that it was, after all, deeply regrettable for her to leave the capital and go so far away.

units.source_text: 但也只是写了好几封缠绵悱恻的情书，派人送去，以代慰问。

en.t: Yet all he did was write several tender, sorrowful love letters and send them by messenger in place of a personal visit of consolation.

units.source_text: 六条妃子也知道今后更无与大将相会的机缘了。

en.t: Lady Rokujo also knew that from now on there would be no further chance to meet the general.

units.source_text: 她想：别人既已嫌恶我，倘再和他相会，反而使我增加痛苦。

en.t: She thought, "Since he already detests me, meeting him again would only increase my suffering."

units.source_text: 因此她硬着心肠，决意和他断绝。

en.t: Therefore she hardened her heart and resolved to break with him completely.
